title: Source Atlas Train 34 public Worker gateway and live native URLSession proof
scope_completed: Created a bounded Cloudflare Worker gateway for production stable occupation_foundation Source Atlas public/reference objects.
Bound the Worker to R2 bucket ambitions-source-atlas-prod without enabling bucket-wide r2.dev public access.
Recorded owner approval scoped to a bounded Worker gateway live transport proof.
Verified public HTTPS readback for current pointer, revocations, LKG, manifest, and pack objects.
Verified Worker blocked root, non-allowlisted object, query-bearing request, and POST request probes.
Added live env-gated URLSession XCTest coverage for the production Worker endpoint.
Wired the default app container to the public Worker gateway endpoint and active production stable occupation_foundation refresh target.
Added live lifecycle-service proof using the same service type wired by the app container.

curl blocked route probes for root, claims.json, private query, and POST

source_atlas_status_ceiling: Green for bounded public Worker gateway and live native URLSession/lifecycle refresh proof. Overall Source Atlas remains Yellow.
r2_request_privacy_proof: The live native URLSession request used only the public gateway base URL plus public Source Atlas object keys derived from domain, channel, environment, schema version, app version, and public locale. The lifecycle service resolution reported no egress findings and no private runtime context.
no_private_graph_egress_proof: No user goals, captures, schedules, proof, receipts, account identifiers, device identifiers, private graph data, personalization, or final user paths were sent in native requests, Worker paths, object keys, query strings, or test inputs.
license_terms_proof: Train 34 records owner approval for bounded public endpoint exposure only. It is not outside legal approval and does not change source licenses or terms.
restricted_source_exclusion_proof: The Worker exposes only approved production stable occupation_foundation pack objects. It exposes no bucket listing, no arbitrary source-atlas object keys, and no restricted source lane output.
provenance_completeness_proof: No new claims were produced. The downloaded production pack hash matched the existing R2-published pack SHA-256.
freshness_revocation_proof: The live native path fetched current pointer, revocations, manifest, LKG manifest, and pack objects through the Worker gateway, then accepted the pack only after the existing manifest/hash pipeline passed.
lkg_rollback_proof: The live native object request sequence includes the LKG pointer path and LKG manifest fetch. R2 object contents were not modified by this train.
native_offline_no_account_proof: The app factory remains usable without account and the affected tests include offline cached/LKG behavior. Train 34 specifically proves the active live public refresh target path when online.
production_non_claims: Not a final user plan, schedule, or Step generator.
known_risks: workers.dev proof is not custom-domain production endpoint proof.
Release-wide proof and full native build-for-testing remain outside this train.
Overall Source Atlas remains Yellow until all production, legal, coverage, native, release, and runtime gates pass.
rollback_plan: Disable or delete the Cloudflare Worker gateway if public endpoint exposure must be revoked.
Revert the native default endpoint/refresh target wiring to disable live remote pack refresh.
Keep the app on bundled/offline baseline or safe LKG pack.
No bucket-wide r2.dev setting was enabled by this train.
R2 object revocation/LKG/rollback artifacts remain governed by prior R2 proof.
